description: Split stems, isolate vocals, split lead from backing vocals, remove noise or reverb, or enhance a vocal. No account, API key or sign-up needed: one free use of each tool per network, of a file up to five minutes, as on the website. A connected account runs it on that account's plan instead. Returns an upload URL; PUT the file, then use get_free_audio_job.

audio.description: The audio file the user attached. NiceVois downloads and uploads it itself, so no upload step is needed.

durationSeconds.description: The audio's length in seconds, if you can measure it. NiceVois measures the file itself after upload, so leave this out rather than guess.

fileName.description: Without an attached file: the audio file's name with its extension: WAV, MP3, FLAC, M4A or OGG.

outputFormat.description: Format of the files you get back. Use wav unless the user asks for another.

sizeBytes.description: Without an attached file: the file's exact size in bytes.

tool.description: split_stems: vocals and instrumental. split_lead_backing: lead vocal, backing vocals, instrumental, and the instrumental with backing vocals. remove_noise: background noise out of a voice recording. remove_reverb: room echo and reverb out of a voice recording. enhance_vocal: a clearer phone-recorded or noisy vocal, keeping the singer's voice.

name: create_free_audio_job
title: Split, clean up or enhance audio (no account needed)
